- apply a goodwill/service amnesty or credit to the April invoice while we reconcile VAT allocation between our UK and US entities

Can you point me to the request form/process and an expected timeline? We27re happy to share the line item IDs from our billing view (attached as "Invoice_highlight.xlsx").

Date: 2027-05-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed resolution: duplicate-run credit + goodwill concession

Hi all,

We reviewed the usage events tied to CloudLeaf27s April billing. Summary: two connector retries (run IDs r-9921 and r-9923) were logged as full runs and billed in the invoice; these were system retries triggered during your migration window. On our side those should have been consolidated into the primary runs.

Proposed remediation (attached):
1) Technical correction: credit duplicate consumption lines — USD 12,350 (net)
2) Goodwill/service amnesty: courtesy credit of USD 3,700 (net)
3) VAT handling: credit memo issued to your UK legal entity (CloudLeaf Ltd, VAT GB123456789) for the net amount; we will provide an additional UK VAT statement so your AP team can reconcile. If you prefer the US entity to receive the credit note, we can reissue with alternate tax treatment — let us know.

Net credit proposed: USD 16,050 (net). We are suggesting the following timeline: 
- Internal approval and accounting write-up: 24 hours
- DocuSign credit memo sent to CloudLeaf: 5/3
- Credit applied to outstanding balance or next invoice (per your preference): 5/6

Attachments: redwood_proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains line-level calculations and VAT split scenarios.

Marissa, can you prepare the credit memo template and queue a DocuSign envelope once Kimberly signs off?

Anna, confirm which legal entity should receive the memo and whether you prefer an applied credit or a wire refund for the refundable portion.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts — East
Redwood Inference
